column5: TLS 1.2 suites (server preference): ECDHE-RSA × AES-128-GCM / ChaCha20-Poly1305 / AES-128-CBC-SHA256 / AES-128-CBC-SHA; groups X25519 / secp256r1. ChaCha20 only on machines without AES-NI (of the 94 clients in the SSL Labs client simulation that speak up to 1.2, all 94 connect with AES-NI and 25 without)

column4: TLS 1.2 の RSA 鍵交換（AES-128-GCM / CBC-SHA256 / CBC-SHA — premaster の形の誤りを区別しない暗黙の拒否・定数時間の復号〔dudect〕）。実装はあるが、照合の範囲（SSL Labs のクライアントの模擬 94 件）では使う相手が見つかっていない
column5: TLS 1.2 RSA key exchange (AES-128-GCM / CBC-SHA256 / CBC-SHA — implicit rejection that does not tell premaster format errors apart; constant-time decryption checked with dudect). Implemented, but no client in the checked range (the 94 clients of the SSL Labs client simulation) needs it

column4: TLS 1.2 の CBC の記録: Lucky13 の対策（埋め草と MAC の検査を埋め草の長さに依らない処理で — dudect）・encrypt_then_mac（RFC 7366 — 相手が出せば使う）・明示の IV = AES_ivKey(番号)（ivKey は key_block を相手と共有する長さより長く取った末尾 — 予測できず繰り返さない。RFC 5246 6.2.3.2）
column5: TLS 1.2 CBC records: the Lucky13 countermeasure (padding and MAC checks that do not depend on the padding length — dudect); encrypt_then_mac (RFC 7366 — used when the peer offers it); explicit IV = AES_ivKey(sequence number) (ivKey is taken from the key_block past the length shared with the peer — unpredictable and never repeated; RFC 5246 6.2.3.2)

column4: TLS 1.2 の降格と再交渉の守り: ServerHello の random の降格の番兵（RFC 8446 4.1.3）・TLS_FALLBACK_SCSV は inappropriate_fallback（RFC 7507）・extended master secret（RFC 7627 — 相手が出せば使う）・renegotiation_info は空で返し、接続の後の再交渉は no_renegotiation
column5: TLS 1.2 downgrade and renegotiation guards: the downgrade sentinel in the ServerHello random (RFC 8446 4.1.3); TLS_FALLBACK_SCSV gets inappropriate_fallback (RFC 7507); extended master secret (RFC 7627 — used when the peer offers it); renegotiation_info answered empty, and renegotiation after the handshake gets no_renegotiation

column5: RFC 9113 5.1.1: an even-numbered stream identifier, or one smaller than a previously opened stream, is a connection error of type PROTOCOL_ERROR

column4: RFC 9113 6.2: ストリームID 0のHEADERSと、埋め草の長さが中身の長さ以上のHEADERSはPROTOCOL_ERRORの接続の誤り
column5: RFC 9113 6.2: a HEADERS frame on stream 0, or with padding as long as the payload or longer, is a connection error of type PROTOCOL_ERROR

column4: RFC 9113 6.5: ACKつきで中身のあるSETTINGSと、長さが6の倍数でないSETTINGSはFRAME_SIZE_ERROR・ストリームIDが0でないSETTINGSはPROTOCOL_ERROR（どちらも接続の誤り）

column4: RFC 9113 6.5.2: SETTINGS_ENABLE_PUSHの0と1の外の値・SETTINGS_MAX_FRAME_SIZEの範囲の外の値はPROTOCOL_ERROR・2^31-1を越えるSETTINGS_INITIAL_WINDOW_SIZEはFLOW_CONTROL_ERROR（どちらも接続の誤り）

column5: RFC 9113 6.5.3: SETTINGS values are applied in the order they appear, and the ACK is sent right after

column4: RFC 9113 6.8: ストリームIDが0でないGOAWAYはPROTOCOL_ERRORの接続の誤り
column5: RFC 9113 6.8: GOAWAY on a non-zero stream is a connection error of type PROTOCOL_ERROR

column4: RFC 9113 6.9: 増分0のWINDOW_UPDATEは、ストリームではPROTOCOL_ERRORのストリームの誤り・接続ではPROTOCOL_ERRORの接続の誤り・長さが4でないWINDOW_UPDATEはFRAME_SIZE_ERRORの接続の誤り
column5: RFC 9113 6.9: WINDOW_UPDATE with an increment of 0 is a stream error of type PROTOCOL_ERROR on a stream and a connection error on the connection; WINDOW_UPDATE with a length other than 4 is a connection error of type FRAME_SIZE_ERROR

column4: RFC 9113 6.9.1: 窓を2^31-1より大きくするWINDOW_UPDATEは、ストリームの窓ならストリームを・接続の窓なら接続をFLOW_CONTROL_ERRORで断つ
column5: RFC 9113 6.9.1: a WINDOW_UPDATE that takes a window above 2^31-1 ends the stream (stream window) or the connection (connection window) with FLOW_CONTROL_ERROR

column4: RFC 9113 6.9.2: SETTINGS_INITIAL_WINDOW_SIZEが変わったら、開いたストリームの窓を差の分だけ動かし、負になった窓が正に戻るまで送らない・窓を上限より大きくする変化はFLOW_CONTROL_ERRORの接続の誤り
column5: RFC 9113 6.9.2: when SETTINGS_INITIAL_WINDOW_SIZE changes, open stream windows move by the difference and nothing is sent until a negative window is positive again; a change that takes a window above the maximum is a connection error of type FLOW_CONTROL_ERROR

column4: RFC 9113 6.10: CONTINUATIONは、END_HEADERSの無いHEADERSかCONTINUATIONの直後だけ受け、ほかはPROTOCOL_ERRORの接続の誤り・ストリームID 0のCONTINUATIONもPROTOCOL_ERROR
column5: RFC 9113 6.10: CONTINUATION is accepted only right after HEADERS or CONTINUATION without END_HEADERS, and is otherwise a connection error of type PROTOCOL_ERROR, as is CONTINUATION on stream 0

column4: RFC 9113 7: 知らない誤りの符号のGOAWAYとRST_STREAMで、特別なふるまいをしない
column5: RFC 9113 7: unknown error codes in GOAWAY and RST_STREAM trigger no special behavior

column4: RFC 9113 8.1: 要求を開いたHEADERSの後のEND_STREAMの無いHEADERSと、trailerの擬似ヘッダは形の誤り（trailerそのものは受ける）
column5: RFC 9113 8.1: a HEADERS frame without END_STREAM after the one that opened the request, and pseudo-header fields in trailers, are malformed (trailers themselves are accepted)

column4: RFC 9113 8.1.1: 形の誤りの要求は、PROTOCOL_ERRORのストリームの誤り（content-lengthとDATAの長さの和の食い違いを含む）
column5: RFC 9113 8.1.1: a malformed request is a stream error of type PROTOCOL_ERROR (including content-length differing from the sum of the DATA lengths)

column4: RFC 9113 8.2・8.2.1: 名前の大文字・値の改行・値の頭と尾の空白は形の誤り
column5: RFC 9113 8.2, 8.2.1: uppercase in a field name, a line break in a value, and leading or trailing whitespace in a value are malformed

column4: RFC 9113 8.2.2: 接続に固有のヘッダ（connection・keep-alive・proxy-connection・transfer-encoding・upgrade）と、trailersの外の値のTEは形の誤り・応答に接続に固有のヘッダを付けない
column5: RFC 9113 8.2.2: connection-specific header fields (connection, keep-alive, proxy-connection, transfer-encoding, upgrade) and TE with a value other than trailers are malformed; responses carry no connection-specific header fields

column4: RFC 9113 8.2.3: 複数のcookieの欄は「; 」で1本に繋いでからアプリへ渡す
column5: RFC 9113 8.2.3: multiple cookie fields are joined with "; " into one before the application sees them

column4: RFC 9113 8.3: 知らない擬似ヘッダ・応答の擬似ヘッダ・普通の欄の後の擬似ヘッダ・同じ擬似ヘッダの2回目は形の誤り
column5: RFC 9113 8.3: unknown pseudo-header fields, response pseudo-header fields, pseudo-header fields after a regular field, and a repeated pseudo-header field are malformed

column4: RFC 9113 8.3.1: :method・:scheme・:pathの欠けと空の:pathは形の誤り・:authorityがあればHostでなく:authorityを使う
column5: RFC 9113 8.3.1: a missing :method, :scheme or :path, or an empty :path, is malformed; when :authority is present it is used instead of Host

column4: RFC 9113 8.3.2: すべての応答に:statusを最初の欄として置く
column5: RFC 9113 8.3.2: every response carries :status as its first field

column4: RFC 9113 8.4: サーバーが受けたPUSH_PROMISEはPROTOCOL_ERRORの接続の誤り
column5: RFC 9113 8.4: a PUSH_PROMISE received by the server is a connection error of type PROTOCOL_ERROR

column4: RFC 9113 4.3.1: 表の大きさを下げた後の表の大きさの更新の規則（送りのHPACKは動的表を使わない・受けの表の大きさを下げない）
column5: RFC 9113 4.3.1: rules for the table size update after a reduction (the sending HPACK uses no dynamic table, and the receiving table size is never reduced)

column4: RFC 9113 5.1.1・5.1.2・6.6・8.4: server pushの送りの規則（サーバーはストリームを開かず、PUSH_PROMISEを送らない）
column5: RFC 9113 5.1.1, 5.1.2, 6.6, 8.4: rules for sending server push (the server opens no streams and sends no PUSH_PROMISE)

column4: RFC 9113 8.5: CONNECTの規則（CONNECTを実装しない — CONNECTの要求は形の誤り）
column5: RFC 9113 8.5: CONNECT rules (CONNECT is not implemented — a CONNECT request is malformed)

column4: RFC 7541 2.1: 復号した欄を、ブロックの中の順に並べる（付録Cの例）
column5: RFC 7541 2.1: decoded fields keep their order in the block (Appendix C examples)

column4: RFC 7541 2.3.3・6.1: 表の外の添字と添字0は復号の誤り
column5: RFC 7541 2.3.3, 6.1: an index beyond both tables, and index 0, are decoding errors

column4: RFC 7541 4.2: ブロックの頭にない表の大きさの更新は復号の誤り
column5: RFC 7541 4.2: a dynamic table size update that is not at the start of a block is a decoding error

column4: RFC 7541 5.1: 実装の上限を越える整数は復号の誤り
column5: RFC 7541 5.1: an integer over the implementation limits is a decoding error

column4: RFC 7541 5.2: Huffmanの埋め草が7ビットより長い文字列・埋め草がEOSの符号の上位のビットでない文字列・EOSの記号を含む文字列は復号の誤り
column5: RFC 7541 5.2: a Huffman string with padding longer than 7 bits, padding that is not the most significant bits of EOS, or the EOS symbol is a decoding error

column4: RFC 7541 6.3: SETTINGS_HEADER_TABLE_SIZEを越える表の大きさの更新は復号の誤り
column5: RFC 7541 6.3: a dynamic table size update above SETTINGS_HEADER_TABLE_SIZE is a decoding error

column4: RFC 7541 4.2: 符号化の側の表の大きさの規則（送りのHPACKは動的表を使わない）
column5: RFC 7541 4.2: table size rules for the encoder (the sending HPACK uses no dynamic table)

column4: RFC 7541 6.2.3・7.1.3: 索引しない字句を中継で保つ規則（受けた欄を他へ送る中継をしない）
column5: RFC 7541 6.2.3, 7.1.3: rules for keeping never-indexed literals when forwarding (the server does not forward received fields)
